Okay the front of For Profit has 4 characters on it.

The original box had 9 characters, and Uprising had 6.

I can't imagine them going with a villain team of 6 characters, and I don't think they'd show those 4 like that is they weren't all chracters.

So is For Profit a villain heavy expansion?  2 heroes and a team of 6 villains?

We already know 4 of the heroes in Broken City and at least 1 villain.

 

Obviously we don't have long to wait, but I will be sad if we get a new panel for Ambuscade, He loses his powers and becomes a major player?  That just seems wierd.

It would also be wierd for the first two promo panels to be non-major players in the storyline.

 

I was hoping for some of the underbosses to develop into their own decks, but they would need far more than Character Panels.

I will be very sad if Proletariat becomes a greedy capitalist criminal.  That would be really sad and a terrible way to develop a character.

 

His character in Tactics he's become a man whose Ideals are out of touch with the world, and is both hero and villain as he fights whatever oppression of the pople he finds.

That is freaking awesome, to go from that to fighting for money needs one hell of a story behind it or it is just bad.  I don't see that story happening between two mini-expansions.  You'd need some distance.

My secret, incredibly unlikely hope is that one is Maia.  Maybe she doesn't have the money to maintain the Freedom V the way the others spend money, and Legacy probably doesn't charge for saving the world.  Her heading up a team on the side just for funding, justifying it to herself that the FV is far more important than the harm her side project causes.

That would be awesome.
